instruction:
You are a helpful assistant that creates behavior trees for multi-robot teams.
Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input: Alpha (alpha) and Beta (beta), your mission begins now. The medicine kit (medicine_kit) is at the charging nook (charge_nook). Alpha starts there; Beta starts at the west ward (ward_west). Deliver the kit to the west ward. Alpha's operating area is limited to the charging nook and the laboratory (lab); Beta's to the laboratory and the west ward. Therefore, Alpha must carry the kit from the charging nook to the laboratory, and Beta must take it from the laboratory to the west ward. The connecting layout is: the charging nook to the laboratory, the nurses station (nurses_station), and the pharmacy (pharmacy); the laboratory to the charging nook, the nurses station, and the west ward; the nurses station to the charging nook and the laboratory; the pharmacy to the charging nook and the west ward; the east ward (ward_east) to the west ward; and the west ward to the laboratory, the pharmacy, and the east ward. The charging nook is the only recharging station. Proceed.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="charge_nook"/>
                <IsItemAt item="medicine_kit" location="charge_nook"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="medicine_kit" location="charge_nook"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="charge_nook" to="lab"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="lab"/>
                <SignalReady robot="alpha" item="medicine_kit" to="beta"/>
                <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="medicine_kit" location="lab"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="ward_west" to="lab"/>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="beta" item="medicine_kit" from="alpha"/>
                <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="medicine_kit" location="lab"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="lab" to="ward_west"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="medicine_kit"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="medicine_kit" location="ward_west"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input:
Mission briefing for Alpha (id alpha) and Beta (id beta). Your mission: recover the linens pack (linens_pack) from the east ward (ward_east) and deliver it to the laboratory (lab). Alpha begins at the nurses' station (nurses_station); Beta begins at the laboratory. Operating areas are fixed: Alpha may move only between the east ward and the nurses' station; Beta may move only between the nurses' station and the laboratory. Consequently, Alpha must carry the pack from the east ward to the nurses' station and pass it to Beta; Beta must then carry it to the laboratory. The first handover attempt may fumble, so rehearse the grip and be ready to retry immediately.

Layout: the charging nook (charge_nook) connects to the laboratory, the east ward, and the west ward (ward_west). The laboratory connects to the charging nook and the nurses' station. The nurses' station connects to the laboratory, the east ward, and the west ward. The pharmacy (pharmacy) connects to the east ward. The east ward connects to the charging nook, the nurses' station, and the pharmacy. The west ward connects to the charging nook and the nurses' station. The charging nook is the only charging station. Execute.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="nurses_station" to="ward_east"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="ward_east"/>
                <IsItemAt item="linens_pack" location="ward_east"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="ward_east"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="ward_east" to="nurses_station"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="nurses_station"/>
                <SignalReady robot="alpha" item="linens_pack" to="beta"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="linens_pack" location="nurses_station"/>
                    <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="linens_pack" location="nurses_station"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="lab" to="nurses_station"/>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="beta" item="linens_pack" from="alpha"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="nurses_station"/>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="nurses_station"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="nurses_station" to="lab"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="linens_pack"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="linens_pack" location="lab"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Alpha (id alpha) and Beta (id beta) are on duty in the inpatient wing. Alpha begins in the east ward (ward_east), while Beta waits at the charging nook (charge_nook), the wing’s only charging station. Their mission: retrieve the heavy IV stand (iv_stand_heavy) from the pharmacy (pharmacy) and deliver it to the east ward.

The charging nook connects to the laboratory (lab), the east ward, and the west ward (ward_west). The laboratory connects back to the charging nook and to the pharmacy. The nurses’ station (nurses_station) opens only onto the east ward; the east ward also connects to the charging nook and the pharmacy. The pharmacy connects to the laboratory, the east ward, and the west ward; the west ward connects to the charging nook and the pharmacy.

One hazard complicates the route: the passage between the east ward and the pharmacy may be blocked by debris. Because Alpha is already in the east ward, it can clear the blockage with ClearPath before passing. Beta can travel through the lab to the pharmacy, pick up the IV stand, and return through the lab and charging nook to the east ward while Alpha clears the direct corridor.

<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="ward_east" to="pharmacy"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <ClearPath robot="alpha" edge_from="ward_east" edge_to="pharmacy"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="ward_east" to="pharmacy"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="pharmacy"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="iv_stand_heavy" location="pharmacy"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="iv_stand_heavy" from="pharmacy" to="ward_east"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="ward_east"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="iv_stand_heavy" location="ward_east"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="charge_nook" to="ward_east"/>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="beta" from="ward_east" to="pharmacy"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <ClearPath robot="beta" edge_from="ward_east" edge_to="pharmacy"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="ward_east" to="pharmacy"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>

                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="iv_stand_heavy" location="ward_east"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>

You know the layout: the charging corner (charge_corner) is the hub connecting the kitchen, lobby, mail room, and meeting room (meeting_room). The kitchen and lobby each only connect back to the charging corner. From the mail room you can also reach the server room (server_room), and the meeting room connects to the server room too; the server room connects back to both the mail room and the meeting room. If you need a charge, the charging corner is the only charging station.

Plan a route, lift carefully, and bring that rack home.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="mail_room" to="charge_corner"/>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="charge_corner" to="lobby"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="lobby"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" location="lobby"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" from="lobby" to="charge_corner"/>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" from="charge_corner" to="mail_room"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="mail_room"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" location="mail_room"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="kitchen" to="charge_corner"/>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="charge_corner" to="lobby"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="lobby"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" location="lobby"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" from="lobby" to="charge_corner"/>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" from="charge_corner" to="mail_room"/>
            <Sequence>

                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="server_rack_heavy" location="mail_room"/>

Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input: Alright robots, here's the job. Alpha (alpha), you start at shelf C (shelf_c). Beta (beta), you're already at shelf B (shelf_b). We need the red crate (crate_red) moved from the packing station (packing_station) to shelf C. And the blue crate (crate_blue) from shelf B to the charging bay (charge_bay). That bay is the only charging station, so don't forget it. For paths: the charging bay connects to the loading dock (loading_dock) and shelf B. The loading dock connects to the charging bay, the packing station, shelf A (shelf_a), and shelf C. The packing station only connects to the loading dock. Shelf A connects to the loading dock and shelf B. Shelf B connects to the charging bay, shelf A, and shelf C. Shelf C connects to the loading dock and shelf B. So plan your routes accordingly. Beta, you can grab the blue crate right from shelf B and take it to the charging bay. Alpha, you need to go from shelf C to the packing station via the loading dock, pick up the red crate, then bring it back to shelf C. Watch out for overlaps at shelf B and the loading dock. Let's get it done.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="shelf_c" to="loading_dock"/>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="loading_dock" to="packing_station"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="packing_station"/>
                <IsItemAt item="crate_red" location="packing_station"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="crate_red" location="packing_station"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="packing_station" to="loading_dock"/>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="loading_dock" to="shelf_c"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="alpha" item="crate_red"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="alpha" item="crate_red" location="shelf_c"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="shelf_b"/>
                <IsItemAt item="crate_blue" location="shelf_b"/>
                <PickUp robot="beta" item="crate_blue" location="shelf_b"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="charge_bay"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="crate_blue"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="crate_blue" location="charge_bay"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

You are a helpful assistant that creates behavior trees for multi-robot teams.
Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input:
Hey team, here’s the plan. The small box (box_small) is sitting at the packing station (packing_station), and we need it at the loading dock (loading_dock). Alpha (alpha), you’re at the packing station and can only work there and at shelf C (shelf_c). Beta (beta), you start at shelf B (shelf_b) and can only work shelf C and shelf B. Gamma (gamma), you’re at the loading dock and can only work shelf B and the dock.

So move the box from packing to shelf C, hand it to Beta for shelf B, then to Gamma for the final run to the dock. Heads-up: the first handover between Beta and Gamma may fumble, so be ready to retry it. Also, Beta’s battery is weak—it dies after one move—so if that happens, get to the charging bay (charge_bay) and recharge before continuing.

Layout reminders: charging bay connects to loading dock and shelf A (shelf_a); loading dock connects to charging bay and shelf B; packing station connects to shelf B and shelf C; shelf B connects to loading dock, packing station, and shelf C; shelf C connects to packing station and shelf B. Recharge is available only there. Let’s make it happen.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="3" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_gamma"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="packing_station"/>
                <IsItemAt item="box_small" location="packing_station"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="box_small" location="packing_station"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="packing_station" to="shelf_c"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="shelf_c"/>
                <SignalReady robot="alpha" item="box_small" to="beta"/>
                <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="box_small" location="shelf_c"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="shelf_c"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="loading_dock"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="loading_dock" to="charge_bay"/>
                    <Recharge robot="beta" station="charge_bay"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="charge_bay" to="loading_dock"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="loading_dock" to="shelf_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="shelf_c"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="beta" item="box_small" from="alpha"/>
                <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="box_small" location="shelf_c"/>
            </Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_c" to="shelf_b"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_c" to="shelf_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="loading_dock"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="loading_dock" to="charge_bay"/>
                    <Recharge robot="beta" station="charge_bay"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="charge_bay" to="loading_dock"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="loading_dock" to="shelf_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_b" to="shelf_c"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="shelf_c" to="shelf_b"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="shelf_b"/>
                <SignalReady robot="beta" item="box_small" to="gamma"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverGive giver="beta" receiver="gamma" item="box_small" location="shelf_b"/>
                    <HandoverGive giver="beta" receiver="gamma" item="box_small" location="shelf_b"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_gamma">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="loading_dock" to="shelf_b"/>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="gamma" item="box_small" from="beta"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="gamma" giver="beta" item="box_small" location="shelf_b"/>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="gamma" giver="beta" item="box_small" location="shelf_b"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="shelf_b" to="loading_dock"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="gamma" item="box_small"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="gamma" item="box_small" location="loading_dock"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
